question: Based on our customer pizza order information, summarize the total quantity of each ingredient used in the pizzas we delivered. Output the name and quantity for each ingredient.
sql:
WITH delivered_orders AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT co.order_id, co.pizza_id
    FROM pizza_clean_customer_orders co
    INNER JOIN pizza_clean_runner_orders ro ON co.order_id = ro.order_id
    WHERE ro.cancellation IS NULL OR TRIM(ro.cancellation) = ''
),
order_toppings AS (
    SELECT d.order_id, d.pizza_id, p.toppings
    FROM delivered_orders d
    INNER JOIN pizza_recipes p ON d.pizza_id = p.pizza_id
),
expanded_toppings AS (
    SELECT o.order_id, 
           UNNEST(string_split(o.toppings, ', '))::BIGINT as topping_id
    FROM order_toppings o
)
SELECT t.topping_name, COUNT(e.topping_id) as quantity
FROM expanded_toppings e
INNER JOIN pizza_toppings t ON e.topping_id = t.topping_id
GROUP BY t.topping_name
ORDER BY quantity DESC
